title: 사십오 초
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Funk with a bright, polished production style. The arrangement features a syncopated slap bass line that locks with a tight, punchy drum kit. Clean, rhythmic electric guitar scratches provide a percussive texture. A brass section consisting of trumpets and saxophones delivers staccato stabs and melodic flourishes. The male lead vocals are energetic and rhythmic, supported by layered group vocal harmonies in the chorus. A bright acoustic piano plays syncopated chords. The tempo is 118 BPM in the key of E Major. The mix is characterized by high-end clarity and a wide stereo field for the backing vocals.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
